subject: Cost of a timed-out / interrupted headless run is read back from the same stream-json transcript (worker-round<r>.log) by the one existing parser when the result envelope is missing
objective: `ticket.py cost --from-envelope <log>` keeps today's envelope path, and when the log has no `type=result` envelope but is a stream-json transcript (assistant rows with message.usage), fills tokens_in / cache_write / cache_read (and tokens_out when every message finished) from scripts/transcript-cost.py `summarize` - the parser the SubagentStop / SessionEnd hook already uses - with a note that says the row came from the transcript and why tokens_out is null. Rows for logs that are not transcripts (codex text, agy event stream, missing file) stay byte-identical to today. No second ledger, no second parser, no call-site change in auto-fix.sh.
acceptance: A1 Fallback row: given a log with >=2 assistant messages (each message.id present twice with identical usage, no stop_reason, timestamps, session_id on rows) and no result row, `python3 scripts/ticket.py cost <n> --role worker --round 1 --model opus --by auto-fix.sh --from-envelope <log> --wall-seconds 3594 --outcome timeout --run-id R` appends exactly one 15-key row with tokens_in / cache_write / cache_read equal to the hand-summed fixture values (duplicates counted once), tokens_out null, wall_seconds 3594 (the flag wins; the transcript's timestamp span is used only when --wall-seconds is absent), session_id = the rows' session_id when all rows agree else null, model = the --model flag (the transcript's model is not written over it), note starting with `transcript:` and containing the envelope reason (`裡沒有 JSON 信封`) and the tokens_out reason (transcript-cost STREAM_NOTE), rc 0; stderr says the tokens were read from the transcript and no longer says `token 欄記 null`.

A2 Envelope wins: a log with a `type=result` row carrying usage/modelUsage produces the same row as today (existing tests test_c1_*, test_c3_*, test_131_a7_agy_stream_result_* unchanged and green); note has no `transcript:` prefix.

A3 Not a transcript: (a) codex plain-text log, (b) agy event stream without a result row, (c) empty file, (d) missing path -> row and stderr byte-identical to today (null tokens, the same reason strings; existing tests test_131_a7_an_agy_stream_without_result_* and test_auto_fix test_no_envelope_is_null_with_a_note_* unchanged). (e) a stream-json log whose result row has no usage but whose assistant rows have usage -> fallback applies (H2).
A4 Finished stream without result row: every message's last row has stop_reason -> tokens_out is the sum (transcript-cost rule), note still `transcript:` prefixed but without the tokens_out reason.

A5 One parser: ticket.py imports scripts/transcript-cost.py (importlib by path, as agent-cost-hook.py does) and calls read_rows + summarize; ticket.py contains no own message-dedup or per-message summing; transcript-cost.py and agent-cost-hook.py are unchanged in behaviour (their tests green); no new cost file or event kind.
A6 Ledger: `ticket.py close` cost_total on a ticket with one envelope row, one transcript row, one null row -> unknown_token_runs == 1 and tokens_in sums the first two.

A7 Call sites unchanged: auto-fix.sh / review.sh / land.sh are not edited; in the auto-fix harness a fake worker that prints stream-json assistant rows with usage and no result and then exceeds worker.timeout_seconds yields a worker cost row outcome=timeout with tokens from those rows (tests/test_auto_fix.py, next to test_a_worker_that_prints_no_envelope_still_costs_one_row_of_nulls, which stays green because its fake worker prints no assistant rows).

A8 tickets/SCHEMA.md cost row: one sentence that a row whose note starts with `transcript:` was read from the stream-json transcript (tokens_out null unless every message finished); ticket.py `cost --help` names the fallback.
in_scope: ticket.py cmd_cost fallback to transcript-cost.summarize; help text; SCHEMA sentence; tests in tests/test_cost_ledger.py and tests/test_auto_fix.py.
out_of_scope: No change to transcript-cost.py rules (dedup, stop_reason, model) or to agent-cost-hook.py; no retro-fill of old rows (#155/#159/#169 stay as recorded; main may re-run cost by hand); no new ledger or event; no resume / session handling (#123 cancelled, #117 separate); docs/DECISIONS.md and docs/VISION.md (hard_block).
outline: Rewritten 2026-10-26 per D-076 as an independent small ticket (old draft depended on #95 D9 / #123 resume baselines - #95 is Done without landed_sha and its parser is already on main as scripts/transcript-cost.py; #123 cancelled). Measured: transcript-cost.py on the three real timed-out logs gives tokens_in / cache_write / cache_read / wall (numbers in `problem`), tokens_out null (no stop_reason in stream-json rows). Read: ticket.py read_envelope / envelope_tokens / cmd_cost (lines ~1334-1480), cost_total unknown_token_runs; auto-fix.sh write_cost passes the worker log as --from-envelope for every outcome incl. timeout, verifier and opener logs likewise; review.sh passes reviewer.json (format json, not stream) - on timeout the file is missing -> unchanged by this ticket. Files that move: scripts/ticket.py, tests/test_cost_ledger.py, tests/test_auto_fix.py (one new case), tickets/SCHEMA.md. Pinned old behaviour: tests/test_cost_ledger.py (c1/c3/131_a7/c5*), tests/test_auto_fix.py test_no_envelope_is_null_with_a_note_and_the_handin_is_unaffected and test_a_worker_that_prints_no_envelope_still_costs_one_row_of_nulls (fake worker prints no assistant rows -> still nulls), tests/test_agent_cost_hook.py A2 rules. needs_verifier=false: the only new behaviour is a fall-through in cmd_cost to a parser that already has its own cases; an independent verifier would replay the same fixture contract (D-028 small-change case). complexity=simple. Order: land first (#117 A4 benefits from it; no dependency either way).

T1 (tests/test_cost_ledger.py, unit through the CLI) A1: three messages, each twice, usage input 2/2/3, cache_write 100/200/300, cache_read 1000/1000/2000, output 2/16/16, no stop_reason -> row tokens_in 7, cache_write 600, cache_read 4000, tokens_out null, note starts `transcript:` and contains `裡沒有 JSON 信封` and `stop_reason`; stderr contains the transcript wording and not `token 欄記 null`.
T2 A2/A3: the existing envelope, agy and no-envelope cases unchanged (run the whole module); add (c) empty file and (e) result-without-usage + assistant rows -> fallback numbers.
T3 A4: same fixture with stop_reason=end_turn on every message's last row -> tokens_out 34.
T4 A1 session_id/wall: rows agree on session_id s -> row.session_id == s; no --wall-seconds and timestamps 10:00:00..10:59:54 -> wall_seconds 3594.
T5 A6: close on a ticket with the three rows -> cost_total.by_role.worker.unknown_token_runs == 1 (fixture).
T6 A7: tests/test_auto_fix.py fake worker prints two assistant rows then sleeps past a 1-second worker.timeout_seconds -> cost row outcome=timeout, tokens_in == the fixture sum.
T7 A5 static: grep ticket.py for `input_tokens` occurrences = only COST_USAGE / COST_MODEL_USAGE mapping tuples (envelope path); `summarize(` imported from transcript-cost.
Mutations (worker runs): M1 sum rows without dedup -> T1 red (tokens_in 14). M2 write 0 instead of null for tokens_out -> T1 red. M3 try the fallback before the envelope -> T2 red (agy/envelope rows change). M4 model from the transcript -> T1 red if the fixture model differs from --model. Not measured by the opener.

interface_contracts.cost_row: the 15 keys of tickets/SCHEMA.md unchanged; `note` of a fallback row starts with `transcript:`; `by`, `model`, `outcome`, `run_id` from flags as today.
interface_contracts.precedence: result envelope with usage -> envelope; else stream-json assistant rows with usage -> transcript-cost.summarize; else nulls with today's reason string.
interface_contracts.parser: scripts/transcript-cost.py read_rows + summarize, loaded by importlib from ticket.py; nothing duplicated.

problem: Timed-out rounds record token nulls: #155 worker round 1 (note 'reports/t155/20261024-030710-1279/worker-round1.log 裡沒有 JSON 信封'), #159 round 1, #169 round 1 - auto-fix.sh prints 'cost 的信封讀不到 —— token 欄記 null' (ticket.py cmd_cost). The claude -p stream-json log (worker.command has --output-format stream-json --verbose) is killed before its `result` row, so read_envelope finds nothing, yet every assistant message is already in the file. Measured 2026-10-26 by running `python3 scripts/transcript-cost.py <log>` on the three real logs: #169 53 messages -> tokens_in 106 / cache_write 171031 / cache_read 8041906 / wall 3594; #155 60 -> 120 / 151496 / 7823074 / 3594; #159 134 -> 268 / 361003 / 34191649 / 3597; tokens_out null in all three (no row carries stop_reason; output_tokens are stream-start values 2/16). Row shape in those logs: type=assistant, message.id repeated twice per message with identical usage, message.usage with input_tokens / cache_creation_input_tokens / cache_read_input_tokens / output_tokens, a top-level `timestamp` and `session_id` on every row, no `type=result` row. cost_total counts such rows as unknown_token_runs (ticket.py cost_total), which is where the 'about 40 % unknown' in the cost ledger comes from.
hypotheses:
H1 transcript-cost.summarize already yields the right numbers for stream-json worker logs without modification (measured on the three logs above: yes). Falsify: a stream-json log whose assistant rows lack message.usage - then summarize returns nulls with EMPTY_NOTE and the row must say so.
H2 Envelope-first keeps every existing row identical: a log that has a result row never reaches the fallback. Falsify: a result row without usage (read_envelope returns 'envelope has no usage') - decide: fallback applies there too (the transcript is still in the file); acceptance A3 pins it.
H3 tokens_out can be summed only when every deduplicated message's last row has a stop_reason (transcript-cost rule); in a killed stream that is never the case, so tokens_out stays null - the ledger must not invent output tokens.
